one_liner: General medical record information regarding the definition, signs, symptoms, exacerbating factors, treatments, medications, and specific cautions for acne vulgaris.

course.narrative: This record is an educational and clinical reference document detailing acne vulgaris, its clinical presentation (blackheads, whiteheads, pustules, redness, cysts, and abscesses), aggravating factors (temperatures, stress, oily skin, endocrine disorders, drugs, cosmetics, and food sensitivities), and general management strategies. Treatment recommendations include gentle facial cleansing routines for oily skin and potential prescription options such as oral or topical antibiotics, cortisone injections, oral contraceptives, tretinoin, and Accutane. Detailed guidance and precautions are provided for tetracycline therapy, including side effects like nausea, heartburn, vaginitis, and sun sensitivity, as well as contraindications with milk products and pregnancy.
